name: Rocks
overview: The Scriptures portray rocks as sources of life and provision, exemplified in Exodus 17 where God commands Moses to strike the rock at Horeb to bring forth water for the thirsty Israelites. This event highlights God's power to provide sustenance even in barren places and underscores the rock as a symbol of divine refuge and deliverance amid hardship. The people's desperation and murmuring contrast with God's faithful provision, teaching that true safety and sustenance come from the Lord, often revealed through His appointed means.
